development: existing user_001 hierarchy development, 41 valid characters; already observed development data
regression: existing user_001 42-character confirmation is now observed regression only; never called fresh validation
baseline: same A, D, hierarchy evidence, complete candidate pool and shared isotropic transforms
guard: every component stroke's continuous normalized-arclength correspondence distance from D is <= radius; compute exact maximum over union of both vertex arc parameters; endpoints included; no output resampling
zero_radius: return exact D; disabled guard (None) returns unchanged H
positive_radius: rerank only D-safe complete candidates that satisfy the guard; use frozen H score, always retain D as fallback
development_selection: lowest terminal angle among radii with unchanged source activation, mean geometry <=1.01*D, each character mean geometry <=1.05*D+1e-12, each component stroke maximum local error averaged across its captures <=D+0.005; require terminal improvement, ties prefer smaller radius; else radius zero
guarantee: per-stroke Hausdorff distance to D is bounded by radius, hence change in Hausdorff error to any unknown reference is bounded by radius; does not guarantee mean-distance improvement, direction improvement, realism or pressure similarity
scope: local positional bound; all selected source points, pressure and within-stroke times retained, global times retimed; no production default change
